evidence.quote: The last ferry moves from 22:40 to 21:55 on weekdays from November.

observations.why: Flat, unhedged factual assertion of the timetable change, with no ratification or operational settling language; firm but still a position to be argued, so claim rather than decision.

evidence.quote: The weekend timetable stays as it is; Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill.

observations.why: Plain assertion of the weekend position supported by a stated reason; no performed settling or ratification, so the lower region, claim, is taken.
